PREFIX_STR.description: Prefix string for the FastCGI SCRIPT_NAME variable; typically corresponds to the URL path under which the web UI is served.

LOG_DIR.description: Directory where auxiliary files will be stored.

USERID.description: User under which the bosixnet-webui process will run.

GROUPID.description: Group under which the bosixnet-webui process will run.

FCGIPORT.description: TCP port on localhost to which to bind for FastCGI.
